component.name: mtconnect
component.title: MTConnect
component.description: Receive the observations of an MTConnect agent through its streaming sample request or by polling it, one message per observation, or send the probe, current, sample and asset requests on demand.
component.label: iot

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Enable usage of global SSL context parameters.

CamelMTConnectAgent.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectAgent.description: The agent address of the endpoint, which tells apart agents that serve the same device uuid.

CamelMTConnectComponentId.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectComponentId.description: The id of the component that owns the data item.

CamelMTConnectComponentType.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectComponentType.description: The type of the component that owns the data item, such as Linear, Controller or Device.

CamelMTConnectComponentName.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectComponentName.description: The name of the component that owns the data item.

CamelMTConnectDataItemId.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectDataItemId.description: The data item id, unique within the agent.

CamelMTConnectCategory.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectCategory.description: The data item category from the probe.

CamelMTConnectType.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectType.description: The data item type from the probe, such as POSITION or EXECUTION.

CamelMTConnectSubType.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectSubType.description: The data item subtype, such as ACTUAL.

CamelMTConnectUnits.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectUnits.description: The units of the value from the probe.

CamelMTConnectNativeUnits.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectNativeUnits.description: The native units of the data item from the probe.

CamelMTConnectRepresentation.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectRepresentation.description: The data item representation from the probe; VALUE when the probe names none.

CamelMTConnectSequence.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectSequence.description: The sequence number the agent gave the observation.

CamelMTConnectTimestamp.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectTimestamp.description: The observation timestamp, the time the failure was detected for a Bad message without an observation, or on asset messages the asset's timestamp: that of its AssetRemoved observation when the agent no longer holds it.

CamelMTConnectInstanceId.label: common
CamelMTConnectInstanceId.description: The instance id of the agent; it changes when the agent restarts. Set on consumer messages and producer replies.

CamelMTConnectQuality.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectQuality.description: Good, or Bad when the agent reports the value UNAVAILABLE or cannot be read.

CamelMTConnectReason.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectReason.description: Why the quality is Bad: the agent reports UNAVAILABLE, the agent is unreachable, or the agent answered with an error.

CamelMTConnectError.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectError.description: The failure behind a Bad message without an observation: the HTTP status, the parser message or the transport error.

CamelMTConnectNativeCode.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectNativeCode.description: The native code of a condition.

CamelMTConnectNativeSeverity.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectNativeSeverity.description: The native severity of a condition.

CamelMTConnectQualifier.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectQualifier.description: The qualifier of a condition, such as HIGH or LOW.

CamelMTConnectDocument.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectDocument.description: The agent document the message came from: Current or Sample for an observation, Asset for an asset message.

CamelMTConnectResync.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectResync.description: Set on the Current messages that follow a resynchronisation: the agent's buffer no longer held the next observation, or the agent restarted.

CamelMTConnectCompositionId.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectCompositionId.description: The compositionId attribute of the observation: the id of the component composition the data item belongs to.

CamelMTConnectResetTriggered.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectResetTriggered.description: The resetTriggered attribute of the observation, such as MANUAL or DAY: the value was reset, so it does not continue the previous one. A data set or table observation with it is the whole set, not a change.

CamelMTConnectStatistic.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectStatistic.description: The statistic attribute of the observation, such as AVERAGE or MAXIMUM.

CamelMTConnectDuration.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectDuration.description: The duration attribute of the observation: the time in seconds the statistic covers.

CamelMTConnectSampleRate.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectSampleRate.description: The sampleRate attribute of a time series observation: samples per second.

CamelMTConnectAssetType.label: common
CamelMTConnectAssetType.description: The asset type, such as CuttingTool: on the consumer the type of an asset message, or the assetType attribute of an AssetChanged or AssetRemoved observation; on the producer the type of the assets request, overriding the assetType option for one message.

CamelMTConnectAssetId.label: common
CamelMTConnectAssetId.description: The asset id: on the consumer the id of an asset message; on the producer the asset the assets request reads, or several ids separated by a semicolon, with which assetType, count and removed do not apply.

CamelMTConnectAssetRemoved.label: consumer
CamelMTConnectAssetRemoved.description: Whether the asset message reports a removed asset: the agent marked it removed, or reported AssetRemoved for it. The body is null when the agent no longer holds the asset.

CamelMTConnectOperation.label: producer
CamelMTConnectOperation.description: The request to send, overriding the operation option for one message.

CamelMTConnectAt.label: producer
CamelMTConnectAt.description: The sequence at which the current request reads the values, overriding the at option for one message.

CamelMTConnectFrom.label: producer
CamelMTConnectFrom.description: The first sequence of the sample request, overriding the from option for one message.

CamelMTConnectTo.label: producer
CamelMTConnectTo.description: The last sequence the sample request includes, overriding the to option for one message.

CamelMTConnectCount.label: producer
CamelMTConnectCount.description: The maximum number of observations of the sample request or of assets of the assets request, overriding the count option for one message.

CamelMTConnectFirstSequence.label: producer
CamelMTConnectFirstSequence.description: The oldest sequence the agent still buffers, from the reply's header.

CamelMTConnectLastSequence.label: producer
CamelMTConnectLastSequence.description: The newest sequence the agent holds, from the reply's header.

CamelMTConnectNextSequence.label: producer
CamelMTConnectNextSequence.description: The sequence that follows the reply: the from of the next sample request that continues it.

agentUrl.label: common
agentUrl.description: The agent address: http or https, host, port and an optional base path, such as http://agent:5000.

assetType.label: common
assetType.description: The asset type to read, such as CuttingTool or File: the standard's type parameter of the assets request, for the producer's assets operation and the consumer's asset messages. Without it assets of every type are read.

connectTimeout.label: common
connectTimeout.description: The time in milliseconds to establish the connection to the agent.

count.label: common
count.description: The maximum number of observations in one part of the consumer's stream, in each sample request of the polling consumer and in the producer's sample reply, lowered to the agent's buffer size from the probe; also the maximum number of assets in the producer's assets reply.

device.label: common
device.description: The device name or uuid. Without it the consumer receives every device the agent serves.

readTimeout.label: common
readTimeout.description: The time in milliseconds within which the agent's response headers must arrive after a request, and the longest silence while the rest of a document arrives. The parts of the streaming consumer's sample stream are bounded by two heartbeats instead.

path.label: common,advanced
path.description: An MTConnect XPath filter the agent applies to the current and sample requests, passed unchanged, such as //Axes//Linear to receive the linear axes only.

assets.label: consumer
assets.description: Whether the consumer also sends asset messages: every asset the agent holds, removed ones included, after the current values and after each resynchronisation or agent restart, and the asset of each AssetChanged or AssetRemoved observation. The body is the asset element as a standalone XML document.

heartbeat.label: consumer
heartbeat.description: Streaming only: the time in milliseconds after which the agent sends an empty part when nothing changed. A stream without a part for two heartbeats counts as a failure.

interval.label: consumer
interval.description: Streaming only: the minimum time in milliseconds between two parts of the agent's sample stream.

reconnectDelay.label: consumer
reconnectDelay.description: Streaming only: the time in milliseconds to wait after a failed request, a failed or ended stream or an agent error before the next attempt.

sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle.label: consumer
sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle.description: If the polling consumer did not poll any files, you can enable this option to send an empty message (no body) instead.

streaming.label: consumer
streaming.description: Whether the consumer reads the agent's streaming sample request. When false, it polls the agent on Camel's scheduler with one probe, current or sample request per poll, for agents behind a proxy or firewall that cuts long-lived responses; the scheduler options such as delay, initialDelay and greedy apply only then, and the delay is also the wait after a failure.

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer,advanced
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exceptionHandler.label: consumer,advanced
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.label: consumer,advanced
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

pollStrategy.label: consumer,advanced
pollStrategy.description: A pluggable org.apache.camel.PollingConsumerPollingStrategy allowing you to provide your custom implementation to control error handling usually occurred during the poll operation before an Exchange have been created and being routed in Camel.

at.label: producer
at.description: The sequence at which the current request reads the values, one the agent still buffers. Without it the agent answers with its latest values.

from.label: producer
from.description: The first sequence of the sample request. Without it the agent starts at the oldest sequence it buffers.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The request the producer sends: probe returns the agent's device model document, current the latest observations, sample a range of observations, assets the agent's asset document. The CamelMTConnectOperation header overrides it; with neither, the exchange fails.

removed.label: producer
removed.description: Whether the assets request also reads assets the agent marked removed.

to.label: producer
to.description: The last sequence the sample request includes.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

backoffErrorThreshold.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffErrorThreshold.description: The number of subsequent error polls (failed due some error) that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

backoffIdleThreshold.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffIdleThreshold.description: The number of subsequent idle polls that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

backoffMultiplier.label: consumer,scheduler
backoffMultiplier.description: To let the scheduled polling consumer backoff if there has been a number of subsequent idles/errors in a row. The multiplier is then the number of polls that will be skipped before the next actual attempt is happening again. When this option is in use then backoffIdleThreshold and/or backoffErrorThreshold must also be configured.

greedy.label: consumer,scheduler
greedy.description: If greedy is enabled, then the ScheduledPollConsumer will run immediately again, if the previous run polled 1 or more messages.

initialDelay.label: consumer,scheduler
initialDelay.description: Milliseconds before the first poll starts.

repeatCount.label: consumer,scheduler
repeatCount.description: Specifies a maximum limit of number of fires. So if you set it to 1, the scheduler will only fire once. If you set it to 5, it will only fire five times. A value of zero or negative means fire forever.

runLoggingLevel.label: consumer,scheduler
runLoggingLevel.description: The consumer logs a start/complete log line when it polls. This option allows you to configure the logging level for that.

scheduledExecutorService.label: consumer,scheduler
scheduledExecutorService.description: Allows for configuring a custom/shared thread pool to use for the consumer. By default each consumer has its own single threaded thread pool.

scheduler.label: consumer,scheduler
scheduler.description: To use a cron scheduler from either camel-spring or camel-quartz component. Use value spring or quartz for built in scheduler

schedulerProperties.label: consumer,scheduler
schedulerProperties.description: To configure additional properties when using a custom scheduler or any of the Quartz, Spring based scheduler. This is a multi-value option with prefix: scheduler.

startScheduler.label: consumer,scheduler
startScheduler.description: Whether the scheduler should be auto started.

timeUnit.label: consumer,scheduler
timeUnit.description: Time unit for initialDelay and delay options.

useFixedDelay.label: consumer,scheduler
useFixedDelay.description: Controls if fixed delay or fixed rate is used. See ScheduledExecutorService in JDK for details.

sslContextParameters.label: common,security
sslContextParameters.description: The TLS configuration for an https agent, such as a trust store with a private certificate authority. Without it, and without the component's global SSL context parameters, the runtime's default trust applies.
